patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: There are shadow people in the corners again, and the voices are louder today. I stopped my medication a few weeks ago because I felt fine. I'm not going to hurt anyone — I just want it to stop.
presentation.triageNote: 29-year-old male with known schizophrenia who stopped his medication weeks ago, now with visual and auditory hallucinations, calm and cooperative, denying suicidal or homicidal ideation, with normal vitals and nothing to suggest an organic cause.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because a stable, cooperative psychiatric relapse without dangerous behavior or signs of an organic emergency requires one specialty-evaluation resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient with known schizophrenia stopped medication and now has recurrent hallucinations but remains calm, cooperative, medically stable, and denies intent to harm self or others.
clinical.acuityReason: The normal vital signs and familiar relapse pattern are reassuring after medical screening, while the hallucinations still require structured safety and psychiatric assessment.
teachingPoints: Visual hallucinations or a new pattern should prompt consideration of delirium, intoxication, withdrawal, or metabolic disease.
Safety assessment includes intent, command hallucinations, ability to care for self, supports, and access to weapons.

possibleDiagnoses: Psychotic relapse related to medication nonadherence
Organic delirium if new findings emerge
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: After medical and safety screening, psychiatric evaluation would guide medication restart and determine whether supported discharge or psychiatric admission is safest.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, turned slightly, glancing warily toward an empty corner of the room
aiImageGeneration.expression: wary, distracted, uneasy — as if watching something unseen
signs: glancing warily at an empty corner
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 29-year-old man in a hoodie, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, turned slightly, glancing warily toward an empty corner of the room as if watching something unseen. Expression: wary, distracted, and uneasy. Clearly visible: a sidelong wary glance and a tense, preoccupied posture. No text, no logos.
